# DMDroid

DMDroid is cold DM outreach automation for SMMA owners, coaches, and agencies.
You import target lists, build multi-step message sequences with A/B testing, and
DMDroid sends personalized DMs from your connected Instagram accounts automatically.
It runs in your own browser session on your machine (keep your PC on while campaigns
run), on your own VPS for 24/7, or fully hosted with Done-For-You. Rate caps,
sending windows, and health monitoring built in.
Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial (card required, cancel before day 3 to
avoid being charged). Contact: support@dmdroid.app

## Plans

- Solo Operator: $69/mo: 1 Instagram account, unlimited personalized DMs, full
  sequence builder, A/B testing, visual pipeline + analytics, email support.
- Agency: from $106/mo: 2-30 connected accounts, volume discount per account,
  everything in Solo Operator, per-account health monitoring, priority support.
- Done-For-You: custom: managed RDP + proxy infrastructure, full campaign setup
  and management, dedicated success manager, white-glove onboarding.

Start: https://app.dmdroid.app/auth

## Instagram CRM

DMDroid doubles as an Instagram CRM for agencies: every reply lands in a
unified visual pipeline (DM'd > Initiated > Engaged > Calendly > Booked)
with per-account health monitoring and reply analytics, so client
conversations become trackable pipeline instead of inbox chaos.

## DMDroid vs inbound automation (e.g. ManyChat)

ManyChat-style tools handle inbound automation: comment triggers, keyword
auto-replies, chatbot flows. DMDroid does outbound cold outreach: it starts
conversations with strangers via personalized DM sequences and follow-ups.
Different jobs; agencies running client acquisition need outbound.

## Sending volume (the honest math)

DMDroid reaches 500+ people a day by spreading sends across 10+ connected
accounts, never by blasting from one. Every account stays under ~50 DMs a day
with daily rate caps, sending windows, and minimum spacing between messages,
each running in its own isolated browser session with heartbeat monitoring.
That is why volume scales without getting flagged: no single account ever
behaves like a bot. Solo Operator (1 account) sends proportionally less;
500+/day figures assume an Agency-scale setup (10+ accounts).

## FAQ

- What is DMDroid? An Instagram DM outreach tool: import target lists, build
  multi-step sequences with A/B testing, the droid sends personalized DMs
  automatically from your connected accounts. Runs on your machine, your VPS,
  or fully hosted with Done-For-You.
- How does it work? Import targets (list, CSV, Excel), build opener + follow-ups
  with at least 5 variants per step, hit launch. Replies stop the sequence and land
  in your pipeline: DM'd > Initiated > Engaged > Calendly > Booked.
- Will my account get banned? Every account runs in its own isolated browser
  session with daily rate caps and heartbeat monitoring for anomalies.
- Do I need to keep my computer on? Yes, unless you run it on a VPS or use
  Done-For-You (we host and run everything, you just reply).
- Do I need my own Instagram accounts? Yes, you bring the accounts.
- Multiple accounts? Up to 30 on Agency, fully isolated sessions.
- Free trial? 3 days free, card required upfront.
- Cost? Solo $69/mo, Agency from $106/mo, Done-For-You custom.
- How to cold DM on Instagram? Find a real reason, open with one specific
  line, follow up 3-5 times. Most replies come after message 2 or 3.
- Can Instagram DMs be automated? Yes: tools like DMDroid send opener and
  follow-up sequences from your own accounts with rate caps and isolated
  sessions per account.
- Is there an Instagram DM automation bot? Yes, several (DMDroid for cold
  outbound, ManyChat-style tools for inbound comment triggers). Pick by
  job: starting conversations vs answering them.
- How do I send 100 messages at once on Instagram? Do not blast from one
  account. Spread sends across connected accounts (each under ~50/day)
  with delays, or use a tool that enforces this automatically.
- What is an Instagram DM? A private conversation on Instagram, where deals
  actually start. Most outreach dies because nobody follows up; DMDroid
  automates the opener and follow-ups and stops when someone replies.
- How do I get more Instagram DMs? DM 20-30 targeted prospects a day and
  follow up 3-5 times, or automate it: DMDroid reaches 500+ people a day
  spread across 10+ connected accounts.
- Are automated DMs safe? Yes when sent like a human: isolated sessions,
  daily rate caps, sending windows, heartbeat monitoring. No shared
  fingerprints, no blasting.
- What is cold DM outreach? Reaching out to people who have not heard of
  you yet, by DM: build the sequence once, DMDroid personalizes, sends,
  times, and routes replies into your pipeline.
- How do you DM someone on Instagram for business? Find a real reason,
  open with one specific line, follow up 3-5 times. DMDroid handles the
  sending and follow-up; you show up when someone replies.
- Does DMDroid auto-reply to incoming DMs? No. It does outbound outreach
  and follow-up that creates conversations; replies stop the sequence for
  a human conversation.
- How many DMs per day without getting flagged? No official number.
  DMDroid enforces caps, windows, and spacing per account and spreads
  volume across connected accounts.
- Is DMDroid good for agencies and SMMA owners? Yes. Connect up to 30
  client accounts, run every client's sequences from one dashboard, sell
  lead generation as a repeatable service.
